permissions.noAccess: You do not have access to this resource. Ask your administrator to grant access.
permissions.notInPlan: This feature is not available in your current plan.
permissions.limitReached: You have reached the limit ({current}/{max}) for this resource on your current plan. Upgrade your plan to increase the limit.

delete.noPermission: You don't have permission to delete this {entity}.
delete.defaultDescription: This action cannot be undone. It removes all data associated with this {entity}. If this is the project default, it will be deleted for all users.
delete.traceDeletedDescription: Selected trace will be deleted. Traces are removed asynchronously and may continue to be visible for up to 24 hours.
delete.dashboardDeletedDescription: The dashboard has been deleted successfully.
delete.alertDeletedDescription: The alert has been deleted successfully.
delete.alertDescription: This action cannot be undone. It stops all evaluations and removes its alert history.
delete.evaluatorDeletedDescription: The running evaluator has been deleted successfully.
delete.evaluatorDescription: This action cannot be undone and removes all logs associated with this running evaluator. Scores produced by this evaluator will not be deleted.
delete.modelDeletedDescription: The default evaluation model has been deleted. Any running evaluations relying on the default model will be inactivated. Queued jobs will fail.
delete.modelDescription: Deleting this model might cause running evaluators to fail. Make sure no running evaluators rely on this model.

export.emailNotice: You will receive an email when the export is ready.

warnings.traces: Note: Filters on observation-level columns (Level, Tokens, Cost, Latency) and Comments are not included in trace exports. You may receive more data than expected.
warnings.observations: Note: Filters on trace-level columns (Trace Name, Trace Tags, User ID, Trace Environment) and Comments are not included in observation exports. You may receive more data than expected.
warnings.events: Note: Filters on Comments are not included in event exports. You may receive more data than expected.
warnings.sessions: Note: Filters on Comments are not included in session exports. You may receive more data than expected.
warnings.auditLogs: Note: Filters are not applied to audit log exports. All audit logs for this project will be exported.
